reviews.text: Paid for the Word of God, got broken features and zero response!. I recently upgraded to a new phone and the app completely wiped out my history. The "restore purchase" button is totally broken. Not only am I being forced to look at intrusive ads again, but I also completely lost access to the 5 Bible versions I previously paid for. I have sent multiple emails to their support team to get this fixed, but I have received absolutely none zero response. This should not be when it comes to the word of God. They take your money, ignore your emails, and leave you with a broken app. Save your money and download a reliable alternative!!!

Searching. I am a premium subscriber why don’t I see premium benefits I can only read 1 bible type ? This one shouldn’t be. I like reading from AMP because it’s more relatable to my life and NIV changes the wording I hate to speak this way about a decent bible plan but why make it hard It’s the word of God

Inappropriate Ad. One of the ads that frequently shows up while using the app tells me that my device has been compromised because of my viewing adult content. I think this type of ad is highly inappropriate, given this is a Bible app! Also, someone who doesn’t read the whole thing might be tempted to click the link thinking their device is compromised. I don’t mind seeing ads on my free apps, but let’s make them appropriate please. Using a scare tactic like that on a Christian app is unsettling and makes me wonder who or what kind of company they are allowing to help fund them.

Terrible Support / Price Plan Unclear. I have the 3.99 version. I say this because I have One Bible version available to me and when I try to switch it all other options are grayed out. Email requesting clarification and Help has gone unanswered for over 30 days. Today I tried to call and their system simply hung up on me. $3.99 for a single Bible version seems like a very poor value to me. Ignoring customers is inexcusable.

No App Support. I’ve used app for years and purchased offline use of 5 Bible versions. Used to be a great app with timely tech support. With most recent upgrade, I lost ability to swipe left or right when reading on my IPad. My only option to change books (or chapters) is the cumbersome dropdown box. Multiple inquiries for app support have gone unanswered. Buyer beware before you make any purchases.

Update stole purchases. I NEVER update apps for a reason, but my phone was having functional issues, so I had to. I had paid $25 for this app years ago because I wanted the NIV84, and this app had the full offline version. The update took away my NIV84, is filled with ads, and is now a poorer version of the standard bible app that most people use.

Used to be good. They ruined it by putting ads in every single time you open the app. And a bunch of them are click baity or in chinese. Does not inspire confidence. Only good thing is that they let you mark a chapter as read or unread.

It has changed. I did love this app, however, it has changed. I paid for the subscription but can no longer listen to the New Testament which I could before. The contact feature no longer works either so there is no way to get technical help. Very disappointing.

Uninstall/reinstall. 1 The was stuck on one Bible version and the chapter/verse/version selection disappeared.
2 Settings has areas not working.
3 Reinstall has resulted in footnote or smaller font. This makes all Bibles unreadable without a magnifying glass.
4 The orange version is better.

Money sucker. I spent who knows how much money on this app over the years, and now all my content is lost and irretrievable. They keep promising to fix the issue, but nothing changes. Money down the drain. Don’t trust them.

Hot garbage update. Thanks 4 post! Hey bout pst thanks 4 feedback,.Um Would take
look,Couldn’t go 2 Cpter/page of Bible ,It’s Pslm’s 89
Last update issue. After the recent update, the first line of every verse is now covered with the search bar. Very annoying.

Money Grubbing! ***REVISED***. I just received an email from the developer telling me that it was a bug and they fixed it. After downloading and logging back in, I am quite impressed and pleased, not only with the app but with the developer following up with me. In this day and age it’s always a surprise when a business listens to their customers and responds! Kudos to!


Previous Review:
Just deleted this app! After years of use I can no longer open NIV, NLT and NKJV without paying for them! All my bookmarks and notes are gone!

Never expected this from a bible app! The other Bible app I have used for 10+ years has never asked for a dime.
Cheated. Was not able to see any of bible but they took my money

I can’t use the app!. After I updated to the newest version, the app crashes after I try and even look at the Bible. The book display just shows up as “unknown book” on the top left corner. Please fix this.
It has everything. I’ve used this app for years. The most translations I’ve seen anywhere. It has the red letters as well for the Christ spoken words

App is not working. Went to check my daily bible verse both last night and this morning- none of the daily features are working. Decided to just pick a book to read from- but they are not loading either. It takes me to a screen that says “Old Testament” or “New Testament” but when you click on it, it goes to a blank screen. It’s not my service or WiFi.

Once Great, Can be Great Again!. I love your app and have been using it for years but please fix the following bugs, especially the first one which used to work fine about 2 years ago.

1. Misread Books
- Reset all your data/reading/etc. - clean slate 
- Read Ephesians and mark each chapter (all 6) as read, I tested with NIV but I’m not sure translation matters I’ve seen this in others
- Attempt to select a new book and notice that on the book summary screen it shows progress for reading Galatians for some reason and Ephesians isn’t marked complete.
- This is one example, this happens for some books not all but is pretty common.
- Also, Sometimes the first chapter of a book shows up as read when I never clicked Mark as Read

2. San Francisco font cannot be resized on iPhone, it renders as microscopic which is unusable.

Thanks for listening, we appreciate you and your hard work stewarding God’s word!

Missing notes. I am missing the notes attached to the Scripture that I had. There is a list of notes but I am unable to open them I just see a few lines. I used to really like this app as it was simple to use and had what I wanted. With each update, it seems to take a step backward rather than forward.
Ads. The whole ads thing and monetizing the Bible just doesn’t sit right with me.

What Is Wrong with You People??. This morning I opened your app as I have for years now, and the literally thousands of notations I have made are gone! I rely on these notes for sermon preparation. You are incredibly thoughtless regarding your customers. I have relied on you for the safe keeping and guaranteed access to these notes. Even my notes from yesterday have disappeared.

Way too many ad’s. This used to be a great app now it’s just full of ads. In church just to get it to load or go back to during church you have to deal with ads. It was never like this. Time to find a new Bible app.

What happened? A little bit upset.. Your recent update seems to have deleted hundreds of my notes, highlights, and research- literally almost daily for years, hours of study. I pray they are recoverable. Update- fortunately notes were restored. Still a couple of things- I changed versions, or sometimes read and make notes in a different version. I did not realize that notes, underlines, highlights are all specific only to that version. If you change the notes will not be there. Also, there are strange things with highlights- sometimes they arent visible but the app knows they are there. I also wish it was specific to the actual words instead of highlighting an entire verse.
Best I have found. Very well done app. The personalization gives just what I need. I use the ESV version but the parallel reading is a what I use most of the time.

Malfunctioning App. Im glad it’s not just me or any of my devices. I’ve spent weeks wondering why this app wasn’t working properly for me & thanks to other’s reviews, I realize it’s the app. It’s really a shame, I loved this app & paid for no ads & for a couple translations. I hope they can get it together.

Update break, then fix, then break app. Again the app is back to being in a newly broken state. I’ve Purchased 3 offline translations and the premium (no adds) feature, and now after this last update, although my “account” recognizes that I’ve purchased these thing (viewed from within the app I might add) none of them will activate or are usable.
This simply would be the best bible app, as it is simple when it works, but unfortunately, they can’t seem to keep it consistently working for all iPhone generations over their updates.
I guess it serves me right for trying to rely on my phone’s Bible instead of a printed copy.
Cannot add bookmarks. Bookmark feature stopped working
Terrible App. App no longer fill in sq after marking all chapters read. They used to have a zone app that was Orange, which worked great! But it disappeared a few yrs ago.😟😩😠
Why did you ruin this app?. I used to like it a lot. Now it routinely frustrates. You should have just left it alone!
New Version. Love the app. Recently had to update and I lost all off the chapters I had highlight as read though. Anyway to recover that? Gods way of saying I need to read them again.

Very sad. I have had this app for years and have loved it. Now after I open it an add pops up and then the app just shuts down. I tried to redownload but it did not help. I am so sad about this. I had to download another app but I don't like it as well.
Kicks me out. Why does it keep kicking me out?
Inappropriate ads. My great grandma added this app on her phone & their were inappropriate pictures of girls in the ads for the app! this is ridiculous!

Hot garbage update. The more these “developers” “develop”, the more they screw up the app… now on the October 2024 update I have to push on “Done” to switch between books and verses! It adds one more unnecessary step that wasn’t needed before, when I chose the verse, it navigated automatically. Why can’t you just work on only iOS compatibility and leave the input interfaces alone!? I’ve got too many years invested on the OneBible app, but you keep ruining my readings every time you update it. 

Lastly, I see you finally removed the Auto-lock disable button in the settings that never seemed to work. That’s one development could not seem to get to work so throw in the towel! Thumbs up… not. 

The May 2022 Update v. 4 is a huge step backwards. On their push for subscribers and accounts, I lost all my bookmarks, highlights, and books completed. The header font is too small and hard to read. Switching between books doesn’t allow alphabetical searches any more. The icing on the cake may be opening the app in church and getting an ad with audio…

Always making you pay. I paid for ad free simple Bible verse look up, now it's full of all bloatware and unnecessary features. Plus, I have to pay for a premium service? Never would have paid to get the ad free version had I known. Delete.

Don’t fix what isn’t broken. I loved this Bible app and used it all day long. I had years of investment of underlining and highlighting needed verses. But two days ago they ruined it. They made the pages black, the highlights can’t be seen without struggling. You can’t access between old and New Testament without paging down and it’s just ruined my joy of experiencing the Bible at my fingertips anytime I need it. 

I love my physical Bible too and bring it everywhere, but this was such a blessing to cross reference having the ability to look up one scripture and look up another in my paper Bible at the same time. 

Now this morning the Bible app cycles back to choosing which book you want to read and when you press the chapter it freezes and sends you back to what book you want to read. How unfortunate they “fixed” something that wasn’t broken.

Update. Latest update is terrible on iPad. All reading progress lost, new reading progress not saved, audio will not play from page to page without resetting. Hopefully they will fix because it was wonderful prior to the update.

Update messed up a great app. I used to use this app every day. But then I updated my iPhone and apparently the OneBible app got updated as well. The updated version is horrible. The features in the older version I used every day are no longer available. Had to go to another Bible app. Too bad. I used to really like this app.
Commercials. Constant commercials, no thanks.
Something changed.. I have the 1984 NIV version of this snd recently the top of each page with the book and verse line has gotten very small and the chapter number no longer appears.
Don’t waste your time. I paid for esv and paid for no ads updated it and it would not let me restore my purchase this is ridiculous do not waste you time or money on this app
Thieves. I had the NIV 84 which I purchased from this company and they took it away and created a different app.

Verses are wrong. About two years ago an update just really messed up the verses in the NASB version. Missing words, sentence fragments that make no sense. I have written many times concerning this, and some updates have corrected some of the problems, but they still exist. If you are relying on this app for a Bible study with the NASB, you will be totally misled and confused. You had better have a hard copy backup!
App closes when I try to open after initial download. Please refund my purchase fee!. App closed when opened after downloading. Please refund my purchase fee!
Forced ads.. I PAID for this app yet I can’t even open it without ads forced on me.

Needed audio for night listening. This sucked. It took my fees for ad removal but NEVER showed I’d paid 

It took my fees for subscription as the audio kept cutting off mid sentence and STILL didn’t show I’d subscribed until DOUBLE PAYMENT MADE. EXTREMELY DISAPPOINTING 

Canceling this app

NIV legacy. Purchased the NIV Legacy version (NIV 1984) back in 2015 and it has been a standard on my iphone and ipad since.

The app startup issue appears resolved. I don’t have to go airplane mode to get it to work now. Thanks.

LATEST UPDATE WIPED MY PROGRESS. I would recommend that anyone using this app to keep track of what they’ve read in the Bible not download the latest app update. I’ve been using this app for years and love it for its ease. Now it looks like I have used it for the first time with no progress whatsoever, very upsetting. Time to find a new more reliable one.

Me or app?. App looks good but I can not get it to work. I would pay for a bible. I would pay for no adds. I would pay for subscription if I could try it first. I was really excited to find red letter edition bible. But the app will not let me make notes or highlight. Is a subscription required to use these features? No where does the app say subscription required to try app. There is no tutorial. I won’t pay for any app that won’t let me trial first

I Love This App. This has been the only bible app that i have opened on a daily basis EVER!
This app keeps me on schedule with my reading!
Its very easy to choose your translation, to navigate, & to personalize your settings!

This is the only bible app that i need!! 
I read more now than EVER!!!
Thank you! Thank you! Thank you!
Love it!. The only thing that I suggest is…to add an option to remove a plan.

Constant Push For Money. 1. App support sends you straight to purchase pages.
2. Sadly the Ad free version bought the farm with this upgrade.
3. All my notes are gone.
4. Privacy policy isn't well explained. Are you going to sell my email address & banking info if I did make a purchase?

I paid to have ads removed... And as I was listening to the audio it completely stopped about 10 seconds into it and said I needed to subscribe to continue with the audio version. That is not cool. There are plenty of free audio Bibles out there and I will download one of them instead. You can keep my $1.99 since you need it.
New Update. Love the app, however the new update is no longer allowing me to mark chapters as read.

Disappointing!. The Versions of the Bible are great. I love having access to those all in one place. However, tonite I opened the app to find a Chinese advertisement all in Chinese language, which doesn’t go away unless I click on something, which I will not do. I find this baffling and unacceptable. I will be looking for a different app and will delete this one.

Ads??????. I just opened my (paid) app to research a scripture and it’s completely full of ads. I can’t even find the scripture. What’s up with that? I’ve paid for my NIV version twice now (because the first download disappeared) and now suddenly I see tennis shoes and clothing.

Long time user very disappointed. Like most of the other commenters here in 2012, I have been very disappointed with the changes and “upgrades” made this year. I have used this app for years with few issues and have been very satisfied. I made in-app purchases so as to help the developers. 

During the last year, however, changes were made that have rendered the app unusable. The two biggest issues have been that my reading history is gone. And that leads to the second issue. We’re told to log in and sync our data. It appears that the data is being synced, however, my reading history has never been restored and I am forced to sign in every single time. 

I can’t believe that you folks haven’t just rolled back the updates. These issues have been known for months. I gave up trying two months ago, but logged back in today to see if anything has changed. Sadly, the answer is no.
Unusable. The app bugs so much that it’s unusable. Every time you try to scroll down it resets right back to the top every two seconds.

Issues. App. Is not stable, keeps going back to the top of the verse without touching the screen. Also no feature to keep my iPhone from going to sleep while using app.

Update. Appears they have fixed the issue of going back to the top of the verse. Next needs to keep it from going to sleep. Hen it will be all good I think. Thanks

Don’t like to be forced to sign in. I have been using this app for years. I am frustrated that in order to mark a chapter that I now have read, the app wants me to log in. I don’t want to log in with Google or create an account to be tracked or to subscribe to other services. I can understand if I was using the free version, but I have paid for all of the versions loaded on my iPad.

new app. the old app worked great for me. now i can only get the bible i paid for in that one if i’m online. 
please fix this new app!
highlight colors aren’t as nice as old app & harder to use. 
i can’t delete a bookmark on that page - have to go to the list. 
i can’t save my highlights or bookmarks in order like old app. 
too many spelling or missing word mistakes. 
i don’t want the footnotes marked, but can’t turn it off. 
this was my favorite bible app. not anymore. please fix it!

Upgrades in last six months are horrible. This app was great until a few months ago. I’ve used it for at least six years. I purchased several offline Bible versions and paid to remove ads. But the last few upgrades have been horrible. Every time I open the Bible, I have to restore my purchases. It’s lost all my read/unread data from the past six years. They are requiring you to register (so they can send you spam emails) to remember your purchases and reading history. I wish I could get my money back because it’s horrible now.

Inappropriate ads. It is inappropriate for half naked lady photos to appear in ads on a Bible app.

I would rate it a zero if I could!!!

Erased data is frustrating. I have had this bible app for years and love it! My biggest complaint and the thing that knocks stars off is that when iOS updates or other random updates, it erases my progress. I have learned to keep a paper backup of what I have read.

Disappointed. I thought that after everyone complained about losing bookmarks in an earlier update that they wouldn’t send an update that wipes out user notes and bookmarks. They must not have QA or test the new version before publishing the updated version. I just lost all my bookmarks again!

Ok but…. I’ve used this app for couple years. Liked it alot mostly cuz I can use different translations AND can track my reading. But I’m going to uninstall it and cancel my subscription due to really just one thing: over and over now every time there’s an update I lose all my reading progress. This is SOOO frustrating. I have no option to accept the new update. I just get up of a morning, open the app and all my progress to date is gone. I’m beyond frustrated - sorry but I’m done

Old version so much better. Liked the old version of this app. New version requires that I purchase all my bibles again to use offline. Customer support was helpful in restoring purchases. Most recent update erased all my purchases again. Appears I’ll have to spend more money if I continue to use this app. App deleted. Do not spend money on this app. Better options in the app store.
The ads. It’s a nice app. I love being able to mark my progress and take notes. But it just seems like bad taste to have all these lingerie and bra ads pop up on a Bible app.
Ruined it. Too many popups whoring themselves for money.

Offline where’s the library?. I need to be able to read my Bible offline. The app says I need to go to the library to download, except WHERE IS THAT? Also, When the new update happened awhile ago, all my highlights, personalized comments, etc where gone. So not thrilled about that! This has been my Bible of choice, would like that to remain. So help me figure this out. Thank you.

Was good, now annoying and unjust. I have been using the app for years. Recently, the ads became obnoxious with video and loud audio. Even worse, the ads for a Cleaner app lie by claiming “iPhone Memory is Full” and “Storage is Almost Full”. Such fraudulent ad claims should not be allowed anywhere and especially not on a Bible app.

Don’t update. Before I updated I paid to remove the ads, after the update I’m being asked again to pay to remove ads. Also I love seeing the progress I made throughout the year as this was the first time where I took reading the Bible daily seriously. Unfortunately with the update I lost all the progress I’ve made and all my highlights. This is so frustrating. Moral of the story don’t update until you are ready to restart your journey.
Frustrated by ads. I used to love this app. However there are so many ads and this morning I couldn’t even X out to get to my reading. Bye bye. Going to an app not so heavily ad oriented.

Still holding on. I’ll start out by saying that this has been my go to digital Bible for years. I have a couple of others but this is my primary. I have been very patient and tolerated so many issues especially following updates. My frustration comes with syncing issues across devices, the lost markings of what I’ve already read and so much more. The parallel option was superb and now it’s gone. I stopped making notes because now the note you make by a scripture is no longer by the scripture it is somewhere else so I can’t refer back to my note if I reread that scripture and I can go on and on but features that made this app my fav has gone away. Basically I ditto “Brent, frustrated” from two years ago. I have sent emails in the past and have never received a response like Brent. 

This is still my go to Digital Bible because I have lots of years of highlights and notes invested. I have high expectations because this digital Bible is to Glorify the Lord and therefore I believe only excellence should be put forth. 
Praying for the team. God has a plan for you and has blessed you with this platform. I am thankful your team is using your gifts and talents to glorify Him with the production of this digital Bible. 

Lastly, I was a subscriber (charitable downer) but the last update kicked that out too. Not sure what happened there either.
But I am glad the last update stopped forcing me to look at certain advertisement. There has been some that one would not want to see when you’re about to read your Bible!

Feels like a cash grab. Purchased a Bible that was over 40 or so dollars, not long after that i was foced to pay for ads seperate. 

Facebook integration no longer works and gives an error saying this app is indevelopment mode or something. 

Poorly optimized, I was happy to support these devs but its clear the end user is not on the priority. which is a shame for a Bible app.

Update has missing words. The apple was recently updated and now has missing words. For example, in The Message the end of the sentence of 2 Peter 2:19 is missing. In The Message words are missing from Revelation 1:8.

Not happy with the new version of this app. I have enjoyed this app for years but I was FORCED to this new version and I absolutely HATE IT! I despise it. I loved having my screen split into one half being able to manage my daily readings and the other half free to go to any book I wanted to read. Now I cannot do that, I have one HUGE screen and it lost ALL of the marked books that I had already AND I paid $1.99 to skip the ads and I and STILL getting ads! I am NOT a happy camper. I do not recommend this app any more. My mama always said “if it isn’t broke, don’t fix it” they did and they ruined it! PLUS because I only gave one star, it won’t let me send, won’t accept any of my screen names and I KNOW they aren’t all taken……come on!

Too Many Typos. So disappointed with the latest software upgrade that I am deleting the app. There are typos EVERYWHERE to the point where text meaning cannot be ascertained. Also the revised formatting now makes everything much harder to read. Moving on.

Disappointed in 4.0. Before the latest upgrade, I could cut and paste without the app blowing up. It was great for taking study or sermon notes. Now if I hold to cut and paste, the options flash up and quickly disappear, or again, it just blows up and shuts down. Lost a great app.

Was great. Now frustrating. Don’t buy this app.. I’ve had this app for many years (10 maybe) when a while ago an “update” undid all I liked (and paid for) about it. Originally, I paid $25 because this app had the 1984 version of the NIV and there were no ads. After the update (maybe 2 years ago) it started making me watch an ad before getting to the Bible which has been super inconvenient when sitting in church trying to flip to various verses, plus I paid for ad free! So I emailed the apps contact. No response. Emailed again. Still no response. Is there anyone there?

Despite this, the NIV84, which is specifically what I paid the $25 for was still accessible on their app so I stuck with it. But as of recently, the NIV84 has disappeared. I couldn’t feel more taken advantage of. I emailed one more time this morning. Hopefully I’ll hear back. 

Don’t put yourself through the frustration of this experience. This app is no longer worth it. They just want your money but aren’t there for you and don’t stand behind their product.
Don’t bother. Purchased the NASB Bible from them at least 8 years ago. Now it’s the new update all my notes and highlights are gone. Should have stuck with good old pen and paper.

Very disappointed. I used to love this app to be able to bookmark where I am reading and highlight certain verses. Now all my past info is gone and the words are all messed up with extra letters added in-between words. And I agree with others that the adds are very annoying to have pop up with sound when you are trying to read your bible in quiet. I really hope this is fixed soon or I will be finding a new bible app.
unable to copy and paste. I have been using this bible for so long but for some reason since the update, you are not able to copy and paste verses, please fix

Criminal. Have had this app for years. Purchased two off line versions. PaId to remove ads. Now, I have to remember to turn off WiFi and cellular service before opening or have to endure ads. And it’s embarrassing to open the app in church and have an ad start yapping. Something’s happened recently where my purchased Bibles will not work UNLESS Wi-Fi or cellular service is engaged which brings me back to ads. And having to make sure my volume is down so they don’t play in church. 

I paid for things that have been taken away. To aggravate the situation I have sent emails with NO responses. 

I am sending this review today as well as another email to the help-less help desk to hopefully get this resolved if not I am deleting the app and going back to the old fashioned physical Bible. 

Not happy with you guys at all. It’s one thing to have a loved app go wrong like a game and another when it is so important to my life. 

I do wish there was someone to call. This anonymous stuff is bad.

Terrible. I’ve used this app for about five years, at that time I paid for the premium version and it was great. Since that time updates have slowly made it worse and now it’s awful. My offline bibles all cost $6 and the whole app is less user friendly. Find something else.

-Update
So I gave this app another chance since the developer said they were still working out some bugs for the recent update and not only are same bugs still there over a month later (the offline bible I already paid for and ad removal I already paid for needs to be paid for again), there is now multiple instances on words missing from verses, as well as words being in the wrong place. They have completely ruined this app since not only is it less user friendly, it’s now not accurate

Why an update that caused so much grief!. I have been using this app for a long long time. I had close to 3000 hours of study time, notes, bookmarks, and tons of highlights. New app update hits and whammo, all gone! 
Why?
So sad!

One Bible app. For some reason, I have lost every single note and every single highlight. I have sent 3 emails to find out how to get them restored. I have not had any response. 
If I cannot get my notes and highlights back, then I will have no other course of action but to delete this app.

June 8th Update (4.0.3) Still NOT Working!. The latest update issued on June 8, 2022, app version 4.0.3 still has not fixed the notes/highlights/bookmarks bug, which has left this app unusable for anything other than basic reading. Notes, highlights, and bookmarks STILL cannot be edited, do not save properly, and show incorrect dates. The app is also still not synchronizing properly with the server which shows 79 notes, but only 4 appear on the app. After years of using and paying for advanced features, I guess it’s time to move on to another app since I’ve already lost years worth of data saved to my account and now I’ve lost faith in the developers ability to fix their issues and not lose my data again.

Loved the app until the last update. This is my favorite Bible app. My phone app did an update a few weeks ago, and in the NKJV (don’t know about the other translations) words are missing in various verses throughout the whole Bible. I can no longer rely on this app. I must go to the non-updated app on my iPad to read the Bible now. Please provide another update to this app that includes all the words in all the verses in the Bible. Thank you.

Bad attempt to make it better. Latest update really screwed this up. It has many flaws before, but was better than it is now. 
There are tons of words missing. It is so bad that I cannot even tell what is being said in certain verses. Ridiculous. Then there are areas where a single word in the text is extremely huge. 
The text is completely messed up now. It’s really difficult to get the meaning of many verses when there are so many words that are now missing. This is a tragedy of scripture.

My notes are gone!. Been writing notes in the margins on this app. The app gets updated and all my notes are gone. The pop up advertisements are getting longer as well. Time to find a better bible app

Missing/Incorrect words. I use the NASB and whatever update was done this past week had either incorrect words, or some just missing. I’ve deleted the app (or I’d give specific examples). I found it in Matthew and then also in 1 Samuel. The passage just read so strangely, so I compared to my hard copy. I know it wasn’t intentional, but that needs to be fixed! I liked the app until the update.

Horrible Update. This as many recent posts said was once a great app…you could mark off chapters as you finished to easily track progress. You could highlight verses and it saved them. It was simple and easy to use…no longer the new update removes all of that, loses all you history, does not allow you to mark of what you’ve read and worst of all it is highly unstable….you want to scroll down a verse and it’s so sensitive your 3 chapters from where you were.
